body:
This is an attempt to document every ClimaCore method, struct, and const used in ClimaAtmos, ClimaLand, and ClimaCoupler (excluding deprecated name usage).


For reviewers:

I think it would be good for someone to go over the added tensor docs.

There are also `norm` functions that are just aliases for the internal version. I did this so we can easily change it if needed. Otherwise, we can just use the public facing version internally.

Feel free to push to this branch

This was heavily assisted by claude



<!-- Provide a clear description of the content -->

- [x] Code follows the [style guidelines](https://clima.github.io/ClimateMachine.jl/latest/DevDocs/CodeStyle/) OR N/A.
- [x] Unit tests are included OR N/A.
- [x] Code is exercised in an integration test OR N/A.
- [x] Documentation has been added/updated OR N/A.

closes #1994 



Change summary (generated by claude)

## Purpose

Make the reference documentation (`docs/src/reference/*.md`) the definition of ClimaCore's
public interface, and bring it in line with what ClimaAtmos, ClimaLand, ClimaCoupler and
`examples/` actually call:

1. every name those consumers use gets a `@docs` entry on the page of the module that
   **owns** it (so `Grids.topology`, not `Spaces.topology`; `Domains.z_max`, not
   `Spaces.z_max`), with a docstring where none existed;
2. names that the pages already marked as internal, or that no consumer uses and that
   sit behind a public wrapper, move to `internals.md`;
3. a handful of small accessors are added so consumers can stop reading struct fields;
4. one underscore function used downstream gets a public name.

No behaviour changes are intended beyond the new methods listed under "Source changes".

## Reference pages

### Entries added (public)

| Page | Added |
|---|---|
| fields.md | `FieldVector`, `field_values`, `Base.parent(::Field)`, `field_vector_values`, `backing_array`, `component`, `field_iterator`, `property_chains`, `single_field`, `rcompare`, `@rprint_diff`, 20 field-type aliases (`PointField` … `FaceMultiColumnFiniteDifferenceField`), `field2array`, `array2field`. `ColumnIndex` moves to grids.md (Grids owns it). |
| spaces.md | `AbstractSpace`, the three abstract subtypes, 20 concrete space aliases (`CenterFiniteDifferenceSpace` … `ExtrudedCubedSphereSpectralElementSpace3D`, `Center/FaceMultiColumnFiniteDifferenceSpace`), and an "Accessors" section: `grid`, `staggering`, `horizontal_space`, `horizontal_grid`, `vertical_grid`, `center_space`, `face_space`, `has_horizontal`, `has_vertical`, `nlevels`, `ncolumns`, `undertype`, `coordinates_data`, `radius`, `issubspace`, `eachslabindex`. Prose lists the accessors owned by other modules (`Grids.topology(space)`, `Domains.z_max(space)`, …). |
| grids.md | `AbstractGrid`, `LevelGrid`, `ColumnIndex`; accessors `topology`, `vertical_topology`, `quadrature_style`, `global_geometry`, `local_geometry_data`, `dss_weights`, `get_mask`, `set_mask!`, `hypsography`. `topology` and `local_geometry_data` come off internals.md. |
| geometry.md | `Abstract1DPoint/2DPoint/3DPoint`, `component`, `coordinate`, `tofloat`, `euclidean_distance`, `great_circle_distance`, `Components` (off internals.md), `CovariantVector`, `ContravariantVector`, `LocalVector`, `outer`, `LinearAlgebra.norm(u, lg)`, `LinearAlgebra.norm_sqr(u, lg)`, `CartesianVector`, `CartesianPoint`, `undertype`, `AbstractSphericalGlobalGeometry`, `ShallowSphericalGlobalGeometry`, `DeepSphericalGlobalGeometry`, `radius`. The generated `*Axis`/`*Vector` aliases and `covariant1/2/3`, `contravariant1/2/3` are declared public in prose, without individual docstrings. |
| matrix_fields.md | the seven `*MatrixRow` aliases, `FieldMatrix`, `FieldVectorView`, `FieldMatrixKeys`, `FieldVectorKeys`, a "Field names" section (`FieldName`, `@name`, `FieldNameTree`, `FieldNameSet` off internals.md, plus `has_field`, `get_field`, `is_child_name`, `append_internal_name`, `top_level_names`, `extract_first`, `drop_first`, `filtered_names`, `replace_name_tree`), `matrix`, `solver`, `band_matrix_info`. Prose states that `⋅` is exported but not public (`*` is the public form). |
| dss.md | reorganised into entry points / buffers / phases; adds `Perimeter2D`, `dss_load_perimeter_data!`, `dss_unload_perimeter_data!`. |
| domains.md | `coordinate_type`, `z_min`, `z_max`, `radius`. |
| meshes.md | `AbstractMesh1D`, `AbstractMesh2D`, `n_elements_per_panel_direction`. |
| operators_fd.md | "Flux limiters and constraints": `RZeroLimiter`, `RHalfLimiter`, `RMaxLimiter`, `MinModLimiter`, `KorenLimiter`, `SuperbeeLimiter`, `MonotonizedCentralLimiter`, `LimiterConstraint`, `AlgebraicMean`, `PositiveDefinite`, `MonotoneHarmonic`, `MonotoneLocalExtrema`. **See "Things to check" 1.** |
| operators_se.md | `tensor_product!`. |
| quadratures.md | `unique_degrees_of_freedom`, `cutoff_filter_matrix`. |
| input_output.md | `write_attributes!`, `read_attributes`. |
| datalayouts.md | `replace_basetype`, `is_active`. |
| devices.md | `DeviceSideDevice`, `DeviceSideContext`. |
| common_grids.md | `DefaultZMesh`. |
| limiters.md | `print_convergence_stats`. |

### Entries removed from public pages (moved to internals.md unless noted)

| Page | Removed |
|---|---|
| utilities.md | everything except `PlusHalf`, `half`, `Cache.*`: `stable_view`, `unionall_type`, `replace_type_parameter`, `fieldtype_vals`, `new`, `is_inferred_type`, `return_type`, `unsafe_eltype`, `safe_eltype`, `safe_mapreduce`, `ConvertTo`, the `AutoBroadcaster` group. |
| topologies.md | `nsendelems`, `nghostelems`, `localelemindex`, `face_node_index`, `ghost_faces`, `vertex_node_index`, `ghost_vertices`, `ghost_neighboring_elements`. |
| dss.md | `dss_transform`, `dss_transform!`, `dss_untransform`, `dss_untransform!`. |
| meshes.md | `SharedVertices`, `face_connectivity_matrix`, `vertex_connectivity_matrix`, `opposing_face`, `is_boundary_face`, `boundary_face_name`. |
| limiters.md | the "Internals" section (`compute_element_bounds!`, `compute_neighbor_bounds_local!`, `compute_neighbor_bounds_ghost!`, `apply_limit_slab!`, `column_massborrow!`). |
| geometry.md | the "Internal helpers" section (`mul_with_projection`, `mul_return_type`). |
| remapping.md | `default_target_hcoords`, `default_target_zcoords`. |
| operators_se.md | `WeakDivergence`, `WeakGradient`, `WeakCurl` (deprecated aliases in `Operators/deprecated.jl`; dropped, not moved; prose says they are not public). |
| internals.md | loses `Grids.topology`, `Grids.local_geometry_data`, `Geometry.Components`, `MatrixFields.FieldName`, `@name`, `FieldNameTree`, `FieldNameSet` (all now public). |

`howto/run_with_mpi.md`: drops the sentence about `DistributedTopology2D` and writes
`Topologies.create_dss_buffer` instead of `Spaces.create_dss_buffer`.

## Source changes

### New functions and methods

| Name | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `Domains.radius(::SphereDomain)` | Domains/Domains.jl | replaces `topology(space).mesh.domain.radius` in ClimaAtmos/ClimaCoupler |
| `Geometry.radius(::AbstractSphericalGlobalGeometry)` | Geometry/globalgeometry.jl | |
| `Spaces.radius(space)` | Spaces/Spaces.jl | `global_geometry(space).radius`; `ArgumentError` for non-spherical geometry |
| `Grids.hypsography(grid)`, `Spaces.hypsography(space)` | Grids/Grids.jl, Grids/extruded.jl, Grids/level.jl, Spaces/extruded.jl | replaces `space.grid.hypsography` in ClimaAtmos |
| `Fields.component(field, i)` | Fields/Fields.jl | the `field.components.data.:i` property chain as a function; requires a `Geometry.Tensor` element type |
| `Fields.field_vector_values(fv)` | Fields/fieldvector.jl | public name for `_values`; `const _values = field_vector_values` kept, all internal callers switched (also InputOutput/writers.jl) |
| `LinearAlgebra.norm(u::AbstractTensor, lg::LocalGeometry)`, `norm_sqr(u, lg)` | Geometry/conversions.jl | public names for `_norm`, `_norm_sqr`, which stay |
| `DataLayouts.is_active(::IJHMask)` | DataLayouts/masks.jl | replaces `space.grid.mask.is_active` in ClimaLand tests |
| `MatrixFields.matrix(A)`, `MatrixFields.solver(A)` | MatrixFields/field_matrix_with_solver.jl | field accessors of `FieldMatrixWithSolver` |
| `Geometry.tofloat`, `Geometry.CartesianPoint`, `Quadratures.unique_degrees_of_freedom`, `Spaces.horizontal_space`, `eachslabindex`, `nlevels`, `Grids.global_geometry`, `hypsography` | various | empty `function … end` stubs added only to carry docstrings on the generic; no method change |

### Moves and imports

- `DefaultZMesh` moved from `CommonGrids.Helpers` into `CommonGrids` (same body), so its
  owner path is the one ClimaAtmos already uses. `CommonGrids.Helpers.DefaultZMesh` no
  longer exists; nothing in the repo, `lib/`, or the three consumers imports that path.
- `import LinearAlgebra` added to `Geometry/Geometry.jl` so the page can write
  `Geometry.LinearAlgebra.norm(…)`.

### Docstrings

About 150 new docstrings, all on existing bindings, in Spaces (aliases, accessors),
Fields (aliases, `field_values`, `single_field`, `Base.parent`), Grids, Geometry
(abstract point types, `component`, `coordinate`, `undertype`, `CartesianVector`,
`CartesianPoint`, the three vector-family aliases), MatrixFields (row aliases, name
helpers), Topologies (`coordinate_type` method, perimeter phases), Quadratures, Limiters,
Meshes, Domains, DataLayouts. Docstrings use plain backticks except for `@ref`s to names
that some page renders.
title: Document all names used by downstream packages

body:
The DataLayouts, Geometry and Operators rewrites of the last few releases each left a compatibility layer behind, to be deleted "once downstream consumers have migrated". ClimaAtmos and ClimaLand have now migrated, so this deletes them.

Every removed name had a direct replacement; nothing else about the API changes.

**Deletes** `src/deprecated.jl`, `src/{DataLayouts,Geometry,Operators}/deprecated.jl`, `src/recursive_apply.jl` and `test/deprecations.jl`.

## Removed, and what replaces it

| Removed | Replacement |
|---|---|
| `Geometry.AxisTensor{T, N, B, S}` | `Tensor{N, T, B, S}` (T and N swapped) |
| `Geometry.AxisVector{T, A, S}` | `Tensor{1, T, Tuple{A}, S}` |
| `Geometry.Axis2Tensor{T, B, S}` | `Tensor{2, T, B, S}` |
| `Geometry.AxisTensor(bases, comps)` | `Tensor(comps, bases)` |
| `Geometry.components(x)` for tensors | `parent(x)` |
| `{Covariant,Contravariant,Local,Cartesian}Axis{I}` | the concrete aliases that name their indices, e.g. `Contravariant12Axis` |
| `DataLayouts.AbstractData{T}` | `DataLayout{T}` |
| `DataLayouts.IJFH{T, Nij}` / `IJHF{T, Nij}` | `VIJFH{T, 1, Nij, Nij, nothing}` / `VIJHF{…}` |
| 5-D `CartesianIndex` layout indexing | `CartesianIndex(v, i, j, h)` |
| `Operators.Weak{Divergence,Gradient,Curl}` | `{Divergence,Gradient,Curl}{WeakForm}` |
| `Operators.{Left,Right}Biased{C2F,F2C}` | `{Bottom,Top}Biased{C2F,F2C}` |
| `Operators.{First,Third}OrderOneSided` | `Extrapolate{0}` / `Extrapolate{1}` |
| `Fields.ColumnField` | `FiniteDifferenceField` |
| no-index `Fields.level(field)` | `level(field, v)` |
| `PointCloud{Grid,Space}`, `ExtrudedPointCloudGrid`, `PointColumnEnsemble{Grid,Space}` | the `Multi*` names |
| `MatrixFields.⋅` | `*` (matrix multiplication since v0.14.27) |
| `IntervalTopology(mesh)` and the three sibling mesh-only constructors | the `(device, mesh)` forms |
| the `RecursiveApply` module | `Utilities.add_auto_broadcasters` / `drop_auto_broadcasters` |

**Exports dropped:** `AbstractData`/`IJFH`/`IJHF` from `DataLayouts`, `⋅` from `MatrixFields`, and `PointColumnEnsembleGrid`/`PointColumnEnsembleSpace` from `CommonGrids`/`CommonSpaces`.
title: Remove backwards-compatibility shims and deprecated aliases
